title: build: rustc 1.99 deprecates fetch_update (clippy -D warnings fails)
description: rustc 1.99.1 (2026-10-13) deprecates Atomic::fetch_update (renamed try_update). crates/mimid-server/tests/common/fanout.rs:279 uses it, so clippy -D warnings fails and every landing is blocked. Mechanical rename to try_update (same signature and semantics); no assertion change.
